emailSubject: FMB News | PBBM Bumps Up Metro Drainage with 13 New Pumping Stations | August 20, 2026 | 1:00 PM PHT
headline: Marcos Announces 13 New Metro Manila Pumping Stations as 53 LGUs Declare State of Calamity
seoTitle: Marcos: 13 New Pumping Stations for Metro Manila | FMB News
seoDescription: President Marcos announced 13 additional pumping stations for Metro Manila as the NDRRMC reported 53 cities and municipalities under states of calamity.
deck: The government is expanding flood-control pumping capacity as dozens of local governments continue recovery from monsoon flooding.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. announced plans for 13 additional high-capacity pumping stations across flood-prone parts of Metro Manila, according to the approved FMB News midday package.
The same package reports that 53 cities and municipalities across affected regions had declared states of calamity following cumulative monsoon and cyclone flooding.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: The proposed pumping expansion is aimed at chronic waterlogging and drainage bottlenecks in low-lying urban areas. The President also linked flood mitigation to solid-waste management and a broader waste-to-energy rollout.

sections.heading: Why this matters
paragraphs: Pumping capacity can reduce the duration of urban flooding when drainage systems are overwhelmed, while calamity declarations allow affected local governments to mobilize emergency resources more quickly.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: Watch for DPWH and MMDA project locations, funding, procurement and construction schedules, as well as updated NDRRMC counts for areas remaining under calamity declarations.
